{{Quote|The planet ''Rion'' is a ''known Rebel base,'' professor!''"<br />"''But&hellip; there are millions of ''innocent creatures'' down there, also!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] and [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]]|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
'''Rion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Rion is one of my ''favorite planets,'' Luke... A gorgeous tropical paradise&hellip; with friendly, beautiful natives...|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
[[File:Devastation_of_Rion_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] [[Devastation of Rion|devastates]] the tropical environment of Rion]]
Rion was once a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a tropical climate. It was considered to be a paradise with friendly inhabitants. Customers at [[Tana's Resort]] enjoyed this favorable weather wearing [[Swimsuit/Legends|swimsuits]].<ref name="TSKR" />

After its [[Devastation of Rion|devastation]] by the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']], Rion became a frozen wasteland. From then on, the planet was covered with ice and storm clouds, and was frequently struck by blizzards<ref name="TSKR" />

==History==
===Dark Times===
{{Quote|I had high hopes for Rion, but seeing it first-hand&hellip;''"<br />"''What ''should'' we be looking for?''"<br />"''Well, consider our own situations. Would ''you'' feel safe living in a place as ''open'' as this?|[[Dass Jennir]] and [[Beyghor Sahdett]]|<ref name="DT" />}}
[[File:Rion_Dark_Times.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A marketplace on Rion during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Dark Times]]]]
A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' traveled to Rion during their search for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]]. [[Dass Jennir]] and [[Beyghor Sahdett]] had narrowed the investigation to a list of planets that were neither famous, nor affiliated with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Rion met those requirements and, as such, was the seventeenth planet inspected by the crew.<ref name="DT" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|It's ''horrible,'' Han&mdash;! All our food is ''frozen&hellip;'' people ''dying&hellip;'' because we ''refused'' to surrender the ''Rebels'' on Rion&mdash;!|[[Tana (Human)|Tana]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
[[File:Rion_frozen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rion after its [[Devastation of Rion|devastation]] by the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']]]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Rion was used as a base by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] traveled to Rion aboard the ''Ionic Ring'' and demanded that all Rebels on the planet be arrested. When the people of Rion refused, the Galactic Empire shattered the environment of the planet, transforming it into a frozen wasteland. As a result, all the food on Rion was frozen and people began dying of starvation.<ref name="TSKR" />
